subject: Close acceleration: 24-48h playbook & owner roll call
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Close acceleration: 24-48h playbook & owner roll call

Team —

Quick, pragmatic plan for the next 48 hours to convert Greenbyte (GBY-1392). We need visibility and micro-owners for each lane. Priority is: contract execution (signature + PO), procurement paperwork, and ensuring Dedicated capacity is reserved for Oct.

High level playbook (24 then 24-48):
- Today (0-24h): lock commercial terms, get signed quote stub back, and confirm PO cadence. Owners: Marissa (commercial/negotiation), Priyom (contracts), Laura (procurement readiness).
- Next day (24-48h): finalize onboarding schedule, reserve Dedicated pool, and sanity-check SLAs. Owners: Michael (handoff), Marissa (customer signoff).

Immediate asks (please reply inline):
1) Marissa — can you reconfirm final price and the two concession items (one-time credit, 30-day SLA epi)?
2) Priyom — are we ready to accept the vendor redline (Procurement clause A.3)? If not, list exact language delta.
3) Laura — what artifacts does GBY procurement need to issue PO (W-9, draft SOW, vendor W-8 if required)?

Attachments: initial MAP v4 for reference (GBY-MAP-v4.xlsx) and our quote stub. I'll consolidate answers into a 24-hour rollup at 10:30 PT. Keep replies short — this is a tight window.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Note: This thread will be shared with GBY once we have a final stub to send.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, priyom.das@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close acceleration: 24-48h playbook & owner roll call

Thanks — quick updates: 
- Commercials: final list price stands; offering one-time onboarding credit of $15k (applies to first invoice). No additional concessions on unit pricing.
- SLA ask: GBY requested 30-day credit window; legal signed off on wording, ops flagged a minor telemetry SLAM note (we can accept).
- I attached the redline summary in the MAP and called out the exact language change under SLA section (see row "SLA-credit-30d").

Next step: I'll prepare the quote stub with the $15k credit and send to Oliver at GBY by 11:00 PT for acknowledgement.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: GBY-MAP-v4.xlsx (redline tab)

Michael / team —

Contract/Legal quick-check:
- Procurement clause A.3 (Vendor Indemnity) — legal accepts the GBY redline except for a minor carve we pushed back on related to third-party IP. I propose the following insertion (we can include this as an addendum if GBY insists): "liability limited to direct damages up to contract value; no indirects." If GBY can't accept, escalate to me and I'll coordinate an exec review.
- We have the signed quote stub ready; attaching signature-stub placeholder for the rollup (Redwood-Signed-Quote-stub.pdf).

Action items closed:
- Quote stub: ready (Marissa, send).
- Contract redline: majority accepted; small IP carve outstanding.
- Legal artifact: W-9 is attached upon request; procurement can use our vendor ID.

I'll stand by to join a quick 15-min call if GBY pushes on IP.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
